news.title: Ex-Atlanta minister arrested in multi-state child grooming probe
news.summary: A former Atlanta youth minister faces federal child exploitation charges after allegedly abusing and grooming minors across nearly two decades, federal authorities announced.

news.title: Judge stays execution of convicted murderer Stacey Humphreys
news.summary: A Cobb County judge has ordered a stay of execution for Stacey Ian Humphreys less than 24 hours before he was scheduled to die by lethal injection for a 2003 double murder.

news.title: Man hospitalized after Tuesday night shooting in DeKalb County
news.summary: A man is in serious condition after being shot multiple times Tuesday night, according to DeKalb County police.

news.summary: It's unclear how likely any path would give a reprieve to Stacey Humphreys, who was convicted of killing two women in Cobb County in 2003.

news.title: Viewing, funeral announced for Atlanta PD recruit killed in crash
news.summary: Funeral arrangements and a public viewing have been announced for the 24-year-old Atlanta police recruit who died following a motorcycle crash on Moreland Avenue.

news.title: FBI Atlanta: Crime is down across Georgia

news.title: 3 arrested after shooting on Wilcoxen Street in Newnan, police say
